chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Hilal, from Uqba ibn Khalid, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) ruled regarding the irrigation of palm trees by the flow (of water) that the upper parts are irrigated before the lower, and the water is left up to the two ankles. Then the water is channelled to the lower parts which follow it. It should be like that until the gardens are irrigated and the water is depleted.

key_terms.إِلَى الْكَعْبَيْنِ: Up to the depth of the two ankles (a specific measure of remaining water)
key_terms.السَّيْل: Flowing water or stream used for irrigation
key_terms.الْحَوَائِط: Walled gardens or plots of land

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic legal ruling for distributing water among neighbors in a flowing stream for irrigation?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the principle of 'priority of the upper plot' (al-a'la ahaqq) in water distribution, a foundational concept in Shia jurisprudence for managing shared irrigation resources. It details a practical method where the upper owner retains a residual depth of water (up to the ankles) to ensure the lower owner receives sufficient flow, thereby preventing waste and ensuring equitable access until the water is fully utilized. This ruling reflects the Prophetic emphasis on communal rights and efficient resource management in agrarian societies.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Muhammad Bin Abdullah Bin Hilal, from Uqba Bin Khalid, 
from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> judged regarding a waterway for the palm trees with the flow that the upper parts are irrigated before the lower, and the water is left up to the two ankles. Then the water is to be channelled to the lower parts which follow it. It should be like that until the gardens are irrigated and the water is depleted’.
en.sarwar: 6. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd Allah ibn Hilal from ‘Uqbah ibn Khalid who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, issued a judgment about water for palm trees from flood water that said, ’Those of the higher area drink before the lower ones, and water is left up to the anklebones; then water is allowed for the lower ones which is next until all gardens’ needs are met and water is depleted.’”
